name: ClickSyncr Form Sync for Campaign Monitor – Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms & Formidable
author: ClickSyncr

sections.description:
ClickSyncr Form Sync for Campaign Monitor connects your forms to Campaign Monitor, so every form submission becomes a subscriber on your Campaign Monitor list: automatically, with no code.

Works with your form builder

  • Contact Form 7
  • WPForms
  • Gravity Forms
  • Ninja Forms
  • Fluent Forms
  • Formidable Forms
  • Forminator

One plugin, one Campaign Monitor connection. ClickSyncr configures each form right inside the builder you already use, and it connects your forms to 20+ other email marketing platforms too.

“Campaign Monitor” is a trademark of its respective owner. This plugin is an independent integration and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Campaign Monitor.

Why you’ll love it

  • Set up in minutes: paste your Campaign Monitor API key and you’re connected. No developers, no code.
  • Your lists load automatically: choose which Campaign Monitor list new subscribers join, right inside the form editor. Every client in your account is gathered into one dropdown, and each list shows the client it belongs to and how many active subscribers it has.
  • Map any field: send names, phone numbers, and Campaign Monitor custom fields straight from your form.
  • Mapping that knows the field: each Campaign Monitor custom field carries its own type, so the mapping dropdown offers the form fields that suit it and keeps your email field on an email tag.
  • Built-in opt-in: add a consent checkbox and ClickSyncr adds the subscriber when a visitor ticks it, and sends nothing at all when they leave it unticked.
  • Subscriber status control: add people as Active, or defer to your Campaign Monitor list’s own confirmed opt-in setting, per form.
  • No duplicate subscribers: Campaign Monitor matches on email address, so an existing subscriber is updated with the fields you mapped instead of being duplicated.
  • A setup for every form: each form can sync to a different Campaign Monitor list with its own field mapping, in every supported builder.
  • Sync health at a glance: an admin-bar menu shows every form’s Campaign Monitor sync counts and the last error, if any.
  • Lightweight and fast: built to WordPress standards, so it never slows your site down.
  • You stay in control: you decide exactly what data is sent to Campaign Monitor, and to which list.

Learn more about the forms to Campaign Monitor integration.

What you’ll need

  • WordPress 6.7 or higher
  • At least one supported form builder: Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable Forms, or Forminator
  • A Campaign Monitor account with an API key

Getting your Campaign Monitor API key

  1. Log in to your Campaign Monitor account.
  2. Open Account Settings, then API keys.
  3. Copy your API key, or create one if you do not have it yet.
  4. Paste it into the ClickSyncr Campaign Monitor settings of any form.

Support

Need a hand? Browse the documentation, check the frequently asked questions, or contact us and we’ll be glad to help.

Campaign Monitor

Connected forms send their submissions to Campaign Monitor. Read more in the Campaign Monitor privacy policy.
sections.installation:
Automatic installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for “ClickSyncr Form Sync for Campaign Monitor”.
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Manual installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the ZIP file and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin.

After installation

  1. Edit any form and open its ClickSyncr Campaign Monitor settings.
  2. Paste your Campaign Monitor API key, choose a list, and map your fields (email is required).
  3. Save. Every submission now syncs to Campaign Monitor automatically. Full guidance lives on the ClickSyncr Form Sync for Campaign Monitor page.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Campaign Monitor account?

Yes. You’ll need an active Campaign Monitor account and an API key to sync your subscribers.

Which form builders are supported?

Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable Forms, and Forminator. At least one of them must be installed and activated.

Where do I find my Campaign Monitor API key?

Log in to Campaign Monitor and open Account Settings, then API keys. Each builder setup guide shows exactly where to paste it.

Can I map custom fields?

Yes. Map any form field to your list’s Campaign Monitor custom fields. Custom fields belong to a list, so the mapping list follows the list you choose.

How does the opt-in consent field work?

Pick a consent field (a checkbox, acceptance, or radio) from your form. When a visitor ticks it, the subscriber is sent to Campaign Monitor; if they leave it unticked, nothing is sent at all, so nobody is added without agreeing. Leave it as “None” to use the subscriber status you chose for the form.

Does it work with Campaign Monitor confirmed opt-in?

Yes. Choose “Use list setting (Campaign Monitor decides)” as the subscriber status and your list’s own confirmed opt-in setting decides whether new subscribers are active straight away or are sent a confirmation email first.

Will it create duplicate subscribers?

No. Campaign Monitor matches on email address, so an existing subscriber is updated with the fields you mapped, and a new one is added.

Can I use different settings for different forms?

Yes. Every form has its own ClickSyncr Campaign Monitor setup, so each can sync to a different list.

ClickSyncr Form Sync for Campaign Monitor Privacy

The plugin sends only the fields you map, and only to Campaign Monitor. Nothing is collected by ClickSyncr itself. Read about our policy.
